item.title: Vancouver man who drove drunk gets 10 years for vehicular homicide and assault
item.description: The Vancouver man who drove with a blood-alcohol level nearly three times the legal limit and crashed head on into a car, killing a Portland teen and injuring two others, received a 10-year prison sentence Wednesday.

item.title: Nominations for Florence B. Wager Awards now open
item.description: The Parks Foundation of Clark County is accepting nominations for the 2026 Florence B. Wager Awards. The awards recognize individuals, volunteers, park professionals and organizations making a meaningful impact on parks, trails and outdoor recreation spaces in the county.

item.title: 1B Boys State Round of 12: Evan Akrawi leads Columbia Adventist to 57-52 win over Wahkiakum
item.description: Evan Akrawi scored 15 points to lead a balanced attack as Columbia Adventist won its fifth consecutive elimination game, beating Wahkiakum 57-52 in a 1B boys basketball state round-of-12 game Wednesday in Spokane.

item.title: U.S. soldiers remembered for service and devotion
item.description: WEST DES MOINES, Iowa — Sgt. Declan Coady had been checking in with his family from Kuwait every hour or two after the U.S. and Israel launched their military campaign against Iran, even as Iran launched retaliatory strikes against Israel and Gulf Arab states that host U.S. armed forces.

item.title: Lou Holtz, college football staple who coached Notre Dame to 1988 national title, dies at 89
item.description: Lou Holtz never met an opponent that couldn’t beat him. Somehow, he squeaked out nearly 250 wins and a national title while cementing himself both as one of the most lovable and unlikable characters in college football — a one-of-a-kind iconoclast in a profession brimming with originals. item.title: House committee votes to subpoena Attorney General Bondi to answer questions over the Epstein files
item.description: WASHINGTON — The House Oversight Committee voted Wednesday to subpoena Attorney General Pam Bondi to answer questions over the Justice Department's handling of files regarding the Jeffrey Epstein sex trafficking investigation.

item.title: Holiday, Grant power Blazers to 122-114 win over Grizzlies
item.description: Jrue Holiday had 35 points and 11 assists, and Jerami Grant added 30 points as the Portland Trail Blazers snapped a two-game skid with a 122-114 win over the Memphis Grizzlies.

item.title: 2A Boys State Round of 12: Columbia River unfazed in beating Selah in overtime
item.description: Despite being a No. 11 seed, the Rapids are in the Class 2A state quarterfinals for the second consecutive year after beating No. 3 Selah 67-63 in overtime on Wednesday.

item.title: 3A Girls Basketball State Round of 12: Evergreen claims program’s first state win in 53-37 victory over Meadowdale
item.description: During an emotional talk with coaches in the locker room at halftime of Wednesday's Class 3A Round of 12 game, a harsh reality set in for Evergreen sophomore Courtney Neal. Lose, and the Plainsmen would leave the Tacoma Dome early after one of the most successful seasons in program history. Neal was determined not to let that happen.

item.title: 1A Girls State Round of 12: Shorthanded Seton Catholic gets past Cascade Christian 35-33
item.description: With one key player on crutches and another in a walking boot, the Seton Catholic girls basketball team found something to lean on. Each other.
